clinical_industrial_research_use.value: Home and out-of-hospital sleep apnea and COPD therapy and diagnosis, used by patients, providers and home care settings

consumables_service_attachment.value: Recurring CPAP masks and accessories, plus myAir app and cloud software platforms (AirView) supporting therapy; disposable home sleep tests

instrument_device_family.value: Cloud-connected CPAP devices, masks, ventilators, home sleep tests and out-of-hospital software

measurement_performance_specification.value: Home sleep test records up to five channels: respiratory effort, pulse, oxygen saturation, nasal flow, snoring; up to ten nights of data

notes: Regulatory status not in the evidence; ResMed devices are generally FDA-regulated but specific clearances are not stated here.
